subject: Camera QA complete: real panel-resize reset, production frozen
body:
# Camera QA: 5 October 2026

QA-only response to the scrum 15:27 BST assignment. No production edits, shared rebuild or full test run. The art consumer's report, checkpoint and capture log were read; their active fixture was not opened or changed. This uses the existing isolated preview, so it is camera evidence, not acceptance of the newly imported poses.

## Findings

1. **Zoom buttons do not reset the camera when map dimensions remain fixed.** They preserve the world point at the map centre and clamp to map bounds. From phone Overview (0.45) to maximum (2), selected Amberly leaves the visible map: ground contact moves from (93.7,430.5) to (-255.3,566.8), with map rectangle (0,237.375,390,306.96875). This is centre-based magnification, not a reset. Refocusing at maximum restores Amberly to (195,406.9). A hero refocused at native scale remains visible through subsequent zoom steps. Do not change the zoom anchor on the basis of the art report alone.

2. **Real camera reset on action-panel layout changes.** Tablet opening Move grows the map from 475.078125 to 505.21875 pixels high, changing the chosen scale 2 to 1 and replacing the focused translation. Desktop opening Move grows it from 382.21875 to 396.71875 and likewise resets 2 to 1. On phone, opening Move keeps the same height and scale, but choosing a destination opens the confirmation panel, reduces map height from 306.96875 to 300 and resets 2 to 0.45. Cancelling restores map height but does not restore the chosen zoom. Tablet reproduces the reset even with Camera locked. The immediate pre-ResizeObserver measurement still reads 2; the settled screenshot and following measurement read 1.

3. **Explicit focus succeeds.** Find on map puts Amberly and Scale control's actual hex (2,5) inside the map at minimum 0.45, native 1 and maximum 2 on desktop 1280x800, tablet 768x1024 and phone 390x844. At small scales, fitting/clamping can prevent exact centring, but the target remains visible. Guide Show it on the map focuses Scale control on tablet when unlocked and leaves the camera unchanged when locked. Manual Find on map still centres while locked. Lock therefore blocks automatic focus, not explicit camera controls. Party selection also focuses the chosen hero when unlocked.

4. **Inputs and run integrity.** Tablet Home, plus and arrow-right keyboard controls respond. A keyboard destination preview and click destination previews on all three sizes expose Confirm and the expected 2 to 1 AP cost. Every preview was cancelled. All 55 recorded run measurements have zero commands and byte-identical trace/progress to that device's initial record. Every hero retains 2 AP. These are browser click checks at responsive sizes, not physical touch, pinch or Android-device certification.

## Cause and proposed next window

`expeditions/v2/ui/MapViewport.jsx:31` initialises the camera on every bounds, width or height change. ResizeObserver observes the changing map height when action and confirmation controls alter the available space. The effect ignores the existing camera and Lock camera.

After ART-POSE-INTEGRATE releases the frozen production files, request a narrow CODE camera window for MapViewport.jsx, viewport.js only if a resize helper is needed and the existing viewport test file. Initialise/fit only on first usable size or a genuinely different mission. On later size changes, retain zoom and the world point at the old viewport centre, move it to the new centre and clamp. Leave Overview explicit, preserve current button/keyboard zoom anchors and preserve the manual versus automatic focus distinction. Validate Move, destination preview and Cancel at all three sizes, including locked camera, plus genuine mission replacement and normal bounds clamping. No code was changed under the current freeze.

Source hashes at audit: MapViewport.jsx E9513075FB4FC6A7E0BC78DD9F4119EC51BB329FC9795C1373151C3A2EB9DC19; OrchardExpedition.jsx 99B81E9DD134D6E040C266606F5D2BB1C67A04F3D38AF0A5040687E1F8694FDE.

## Evidence

- camera-audit-20261005.json: labelled DOM geometry, camera transforms, complete exposed trace/progress and equality checks
- camera-phone-max-offscreen.png and camera-phone-max-refocused.png
- camera-{phone,tablet,desktop}-{before,after}-move.png
- camera-tablet-locked-move.png
- camera-tablet-keyboard-preview.txt and camera-{phone,tablet,desktop}-click-preview.txt

The empty semantic station `g[role=img]` has zero-size geometry. Early object-box measurements are expressly invalidated in the JSON; corrected object hex geometry is the valid focus evidence. Screenshot/render settling is required after ResizeObserver changes. Browser viewport overrides were reset after capture. Whole Orchard acceptance remains incomplete: browser wins cover 23/25 family tiers, not all required routes, teams, final banks, integrated/offline/device acceptance or art acceptance.
